## Definition of Done
<!-- Check the boxes that apply; link evidence (test output, URLs). -->
- [ ] Change is scoped and does not introduce unrelated edits.
- [ ] Financial/logic changes include exact-value tests (not just "> 0").
- [ ] Tests added/updated, and `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm run typecheck:scripts` pass.
- [ ] `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds (with `SITE_URL` set).
- [ ] No fabricated/unsourced data; claims are qualified ("as of", "illustrative").
